gap_topic: whether the 30.00 minimum is compared against the cart value before discounts or the amount after discounts

prd_facts.fact: There is a minimum order of 30.00 for every customer, VIP or not, with or without a coupon.
An order of exactly 30.00 is accepted and an order below 30.00 is refused with a ValueError.
Shipping, the discount rules, rounding and the receipt layout do not change.
Applies to every order from now on, with no flag and no migration.
